name: Back Squat
instructions: Bar on upper traps. Brace, descend until hip crease is below the top of the knee, drive up keeping bar over midfoot.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Bar over midfoot. Grip just outside knees. Squeeze chest up, push the floor away. Lock out by squeezing glutes.

name: Bench Press
instructions: Tight upper back, feet planted. Lower bar to mid-chest, press over the shoulders.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Bar at front of shoulders. Brace hard, press straight up, finish with bar over the back of the head.

name: Power Clean
instructions: Pull from the floor, accelerate at the hip, shrug, catch in a quarter-squat with elbows high.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Bar in front rack, elbows up. Stay vertical through the descent, drive up keeping torso tall.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Soft knees. Push hips back keeping bar against legs. Stop when hamstrings cap their stretch, drive hips forward.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders. Pull chest to bar, control the descent.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Underhand grip shoulder-width. Pull chin over the bar, control to a full hang each rep.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge to ~45°. Pull bar to lower chest / upper abs, squeeze shoulder blades, control the negative.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: One knee on bench. Row dumbbell to hip, squeeze lat, lower under control.

name: Incline Bench Press
instructions: Bench at 30–45°. Lower bar to upper chest, press over the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lower dumbbells to chest level, press up and slightly together at the top.

name: Dip
instructions: Slight forward lean for chest, vertical for triceps. Lower until upper arms are parallel, press to lockout.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward, drop the back knee toward the floor, drive through the front heel to the next step.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot on bench. Drop the back knee, drive through the front heel. Front shin stays roughly vertical.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on bench, bar across hips. Drive hips up to lockout, ribs down, squeeze glutes.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Plank position. Lower chest to floor, press to full lockout. Body in one straight line.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Wide overhand grip. Pull bar to upper chest, lead with the elbows, control the return.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Tall chest. Pull handle to lower ribs, squeeze shoulder blades, return with control.

name: Bicep Curl
instructions: Elbows pinned to sides. Curl up, squeeze, lower under control.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Neutral grip. Curl up, squeeze, lower under control.

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Elbows tight to sides. Push down to lockout, control the return.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Dumbbell overhead, elbows close. Lower behind head, extend to lockout.

name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Slight forward lean. Raise dumbbells to shoulder height, lead with the elbows.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Rope attachment at face height. Pull rope to forehead, externally rotate, squeeze rear delts.

name: Calf Raise
instructions: Press up onto the balls of the feet, full stretch at the bottom.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms down, ribs pulled toward hips, glutes squeezed. Hold one straight line.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from bar. Raise legs to parallel or higher, control the descent — no swinging.

name: Run
instructions: Steady-state, intervals, or sprints depending on the day's target.

name: Row Erg
instructions: Legs, back, arms — in that order. Recover arms, back, legs.

name: Air Bike
instructions: Drive arms and legs together. Calorie or distance targets.

name: Bike
instructions: Steady-state or interval work.

name: Ruck
instructions: Walk with a loaded pack. Track distance, time, and load.
